projectTitle: paprika3d (three.js MCP server and Claude Code plugin)
description: Three.js MCP server and Claude Code plugin: screenshot, play, test and profile the three.js, React Three Fiber and WebGL pages your coding agent builds. paprika3d is the toolset that makes your coding agent a better three.js developer, in headless Chrome on a paused, seeded clock.
rules: After writing or changing a three.js, React Three Fiber or WebGL page, open it with game_open and look at it with game_look before saying it is done.
Read the Never visible line of game_look: an object far smaller than the scene is at the wrong scale.
Drive the page with game_act on an exact frame and read the state it returns; step time with game_clock.

A game whose rules must be checked exposes window.__game with describe, observe, act and setState, starts playing on load, takes time only from requestAnimationFrame or performance.now and randomness only from Math.random.
